responsibility: This header defines the `olympus_tunings` microarchitectural cost model for NVIDIA Olympus in the AArch64 backend. It packages Olympus-specific register-move costs, detailed AdvSIMD and SVE vector cost tables, scalar/Advsimd/SVE issue-resource descriptions, disabled-prefetch settings, memory-move costs, issue rate, fusible-operation mask, alignment preferences, reassociation widths, SVE width selection, extra tune flags, and LDP/STP policy, giving GCC the per-core `tune_params` data used by instruction costing, vectorization profitability, and code-shape heuristics when tuning for Olympus.
